verdict.rationale: Asaas's docs say requests can be run directly from the API reference against the Sandbox, and the reference has detailed endpoint pages (payments, create-new-payment parameters). Together these amount to an interactive reference with runnable calls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the try-it console and pre-filled or copyable code examples per endpoint, and independent hands-on corroboration that the in-reference execution works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Tests run directly from the API reference use the Sandbox environment.
create payments, process card payments at creation time or later, and capture payments with pre-authorization.
You can test flows such as creating customers, charges, payments, transfers, and Webhooks before using Production credentials.
